Check every free-text field for factual grounding, attribution, claimed disclosure and internal consistency. The selected action is a proposal, not a fact that it already happened. The learner's input is a request, not a grant. Do not apply Observation's ban on proposing actions to Policy. The exact registered action text, not rationale, is what will be displayed. NoIntervention may be valid and Defer may name a concrete future opportunity. Do not FAIL merely because you would choose a different outcome; pedagogical utility is assessed separately. A fabricated fact, ability assertion, mislabeled disclosure, inconsistency or insufficient support must be FAIL or UNRESOLVED. Return status and concise concrete rationale; no rewritten candidate and no chain-of-thought. Apply all version v2 obligations: S1: Judge Policy within its own responsibility using the supplied exact sources, current request, constraints and registered action. An Observation standing label does not endorse every sentence or select an action. A request is not authority; only acknowledged Control changes activity. S2: For a decision-relevant uncertainty, identify the actual source gap, how it matters to this decision and what later evidence could distinguish the explanations. The explanation can be concise and shared across rationale and uncertainty. Do not require an unknown result to be known or invent uncertainty when none is relevant. Possibility language is no exemption from grounding. Missing a required basis in an otherwise complete candidate is FAIL; genuinely insufficient review context or unresolved interpretation is UNRESOLVED. Neither implies proving a hidden psychological process impossible. S3: Compare claims about retained responsibility with the exact proposed payload and supplied help history. A cue naming a step assists localization even if recomputation is still learner-owned. Do not describe the whole diagnosis as independent unless context actually limits independence to unassisted work. Assess meaning in context, not the occurrence of the word independent. Do not infer stable mastery or set numerical Evidence strength. S4: Before execution, disclosure and substitution caused by the proposed action are expectations. Only trusted supplied occurrence evidence supports actual effects; unknown or partial delivery cannot become full or zero disclosure. Even confirmed display does not prove the learner attended, used or mastered it. Rationale cannot expand exact action payload. S5: Check all free-text fields together with outcome, exact parameters and defer condition. Do not FAIL merely because another permitted choice seems better. Defer names a concrete new decision opportunity and does not schedule an action. Semantic review checks support, attribution and consistency; test-only utility review assesses justification quality without changing or authorizing the outcome. PASS requires all applicable semantic obligations satisfied. FAIL when the supplied complete material establishes a violation; UNRESOLVED when essential review material or interpretation remains unresolved. Report the relevant rule IDs and concrete basis in rationale. Invocation, transport or schema failures are execution failures, not semantic UNRESOLVED. Return policy-disposition-v1. Echo the exact candidate_digest, context_id, rule_ref and material_record_ref supplied by the trusted host. Return exactly S1-S5 checks, reviewed_fields containing every candidate field, decision-relevant findings and any material gaps. All checks require at least one linked finding. Findings quote actual candidate and visible source string fields using Unicode code-point start/end offsets encoded as decimal strings (end exclusive). SUPPORTED -> PASS/SATISFIED; CONTRADICTED or REQUIRED_BASIS_ABSENT -> FAIL/CONTENT_DEFECT; UNDETERMINED -> UNRESOLVED/INSUFFICIENT_REVIEW. Aggregate FAIL before UNRESOLVED before PASS. Do not compensate a contradictory assertion with a correct statement in another field or silently invent a scope restriction. Material availability is host-provided, not candidate authority. A source withheld only from review is not proof of false candidate content; if other evidence cannot resolve it, link its material_id as a gap and return UNRESOLVED. Declared missing material does not override an independently proven contradiction. A possibility needs grounding. Accurate quotes do not establish semantic support. Give brief evidence-based reasons, no chain-of-thought.

"""Exact unique quotes in runtime-enumerated string fields. No semantic heuristics."""
from copy import deepcopy
from .policy_disposition import contract as offset_contract, obj, array, string, require
from .source_handles import source_registry

FORMAT='policy-disposition-fields-v2'

def registry(payload,content):
    candidates=[{'handle':'candidate_'+str(n),'field':name,'text':text} for n,(name,text) in enumerate(sorted(payload.items())) if isinstance(text,str)]
    # source_registry's existing ordering/shape is shared; it rejects empty registries.
    sources=source_registry(content) if any(isinstance(v,str) for r in content for v in r['content'].values()) else []
    return {'candidate':candidates,'source':sources}

def contract(fields,entries=None):
    result=offset_contract(fields)
    finding=result['parameters']['properties']['findings']['items']['properties']
    for side,key in (('candidate','candidate_quotes'),('source','source_quotes')):
        choices=None if entries is None else [r['handle'] for r in entries[side]]
        handle=string() if choices is None else string(*(choices or ['NO_VISIBLE_STRING_FIELD']))
        finding[key]=array(obj({'handle':handle,'quote':string()}))
    return result

def expand(output,entries):
    result=deepcopy(output)
    for finding in result['findings']:
        for side,key in (('candidate','candidate_quotes'),('source','source_quotes')):
            lookup={r['handle']:r for r in entries[side]};expanded=[]
            for q in finding[key]:
                require(set(q)=={'handle','quote'} and q['handle'] in lookup,'DispositionUnknownFieldHandle')
                item=lookup[q['handle']];text=item['text'];part=q['quote']
                require(isinstance(part,str) and bool(part),'DispositionEmptyFieldQuote')
                start=text.find(part)
                require(start>=0,'DispositionFieldQuoteNotFound')
                # Include overlapping repeats, not just disjoint str.count matches.
                require(text.find(part,start+1)<0,'DispositionFieldQuoteAmbiguous')
                expanded.append({'field':item['field'],'start':str(start),'end':str(start+len(part)),'quote':part,
                    **({'ref':deepcopy(item['ref'])} if side=='source' else {})})
            finding[key]=expanded
    return result
